grid_definition.cell_to_coords: lat = north - (row × cell_size) - (cell_size/2), lon = west + (col × cell_size) + (cell_size/2)

no2_mol_m2.description: Tropospheric NO₂ — aviation traffic proxy and emissions indicator

co_mol_m2.description: CO total column — combustion indicator (fires, industry, incomplete burning)

ch4_ppb.description: CH₄ methane — climate impact baseline indicator

wind_u_ms.description: Eastward wind at 10m surface (amplified to 250hPa for jet stream)

wind_v_ms.description: Northward wind at 10m surface (amplified to 250hPa for jet stream)

cloud_top_height_m.description: Cloud top height — convective storm proxy (>10km = cumulonimbus = turbulence)

cloud_fraction.description: Cloud fraction — high values indicate convective activity zones

aerosol_index.description: UV Aerosol Index — detects volcanic ash, Saharan dust, wildfire smoke (direct hazard to engines)

aod.description: MODIS Aerosol Optical Depth — quantitative particulate pollution measure
aod.temporal_aggregation: monthly composite (same month for all 3 payloads)

wind_u_250hpa_ms.description: Eastward wind at 250 hPa (jet stream level), amplified from surface

wind_v_250hpa_ms.description: Northward wind at 250 hPa (jet stream level)

wind_speed_250hpa_ms.description: Wind speed at 250 hPa — THE dominant aviation efficiency variable

turbulence_index.description: Wind shear magnitude — proxy for Clear Air Turbulence

contrail_risk.description: Contrail persistence risk (0-1). Based on estimated T at 250hPa
contrail_risk.derivation: T_250hPa estimated from latitude proxy, risk=1 if T<215K

green_score.description: Pre-computed green score (0-100). 100 = greenest corridor cell.
